description: Configuration and build script for UEFI EDK2 Firmware targeting Arm platforms, including build setup, dependencies, and deployment steps.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares build configuration by modifying tool definitions.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the firmware using the build system, applying necessary patches and copying configuration templates.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built firmware binary into the designated directory.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Deploys firmware images to the deployment directory.
